title: The same-session carried-failure refusal tells a blocked executor to unpin the task's evaluation mode, which Engram now refuses
outcome: When termal_evaluate_acceptance refuses a same_session evaluation because a carried failure needs acknowledgement by an evaluator that never held the run, the refusal names only remedies the requester can actually take. A blocked executor is pointed to admitting independent_session in the project policy, or to asking a never-holder planner or the coordinator to change the pin. It is never told to unpin the mode itself, which Engram refuses under Engram w-360e6ca406fb.
acceptance: A test first fails on unchanged code: the same-session carried-failure refusal (src/acceptance_evaluation_api.rs, the `supersedes_required` branch around line 1303) tells the requester to 'unpin the task's evaluation mode'.

The refusal text names the remedies the requester can take (admit independent_session in the project's Engram policy; ask a never-holder planner or the coordinator to change the pin) and no longer advises the executor to unpin; its HTTP status, refusal condition and every other refusal are unchanged. A test asserts the new text and the absence of the self-unpin advice.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree; its run directory and fingerprint are cited in a note.
